title: With a civilian excuse, China is collecting militarily useful weather data abroad | The Strategist
paragraphs: A global meteorological warning system has become an excuse for China to embed AI-feeding weather stations on foreign territory, gathering data that would help its armed forces in war.
Solomon Islands and countries surrounding India are among the many locations at which the system is collecting weather data, and perhaps other information, then sending it back to China.

By embedding what it calls the Mazu AI Weather Forecasting System in foreign countries, including several developing nations which have all signed up to the Belt and Road Initiative, China has found another way to increase their dependency on it, this time in the vital area of weather warning and disaster mitigation.
